assumptions.ROM: First sector at 0xb4060000, SP 0xb409f000, CPSR 0x1d3 and Unicorn CP15 defaults are synthetic. The boot-code word starts with an unsupported sentinel and must be set by block 0.
assumptions.peripherals: Unknown reset words use the declared synthetic seed. Timer advances 2400 ticks per read; UART and I2C FIFO are ready. I2C transfers use a register file. DDR PHY and controller follow scenario rules.
assumptions.DRAM: The comparison harness models sparse aliasing, training outcomes and diagnostic faults. After 0xb4065440 existing mapped bytes stay live; new accesses use bounded linear RAM. Analog and cache effects are unknown.
assumptions.app.bin: A CHIPID request for 0x746e3531 completes with zero data; the synthetic revision word is 0x41. Unsupported write paths stop before storage changes.
assumptions.U-Boot: Startup, relocation, full driver initialization and full board data are unavailable. Bounded invocations take the loaded payload and raw AFI. MMC pin mux starts from the live loader word.
assumptions.storage: Only the selected SD controller has a verified backing image. Secondary card init is a supplied outcome. Unbacked persistent environment reads are modeled unavailable.
assumptions.handoff: Only the pinned in-place initrd/FDT policy and ARM legacy zImage entry are supported. The LMB models input FDT reservations and a fixed bounded helper scratch window. Runtime U-Boot relocation is unknown.
assumptions.strap: GPIOC6 is an independent U-Boot variant input, separate from the loader GPIOC10 loopback input. SN absent.

environment_after.bootargs: console=ttyS3 earlyprintk clk_ignore_unused selinux=0 loglevel=4 androidboot.dvfslevel=0x705x allenS500=1 androidboot.bootdev=sd boot_dev=sd2

assumptions: machid defaults to zero in modeled board data

callees.effect: SCTLR.C and SCTLR.M cleared (dcache+MMU off) after flush
